tagline: Modern South Tangerang batik by Datik Daryanti, spanning fabric, apparel and accessories.

story.title: Modern South Tangerang batik by Datik Daryanti, spanning fabric, apparel and accessories.
story.body: BRI, BTN and national media profiles document Datik Daryanti as the founder of Datik Batik in Tangerang Selatan. Public coverage describes fabric, dresses, shirts, outerwear and accessories made with hand-printing, cap and tulis techniques. Sources differ on whether the business began in 2012 or 2014, so this profile avoids presenting a single founding year as undisputed fact.
